payload.reason: Resolve the alerted service to its exact graph id.
Resolve the alerted service to its exact graph id.
payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH (n)
WHERE labels(n)[0] IN ['Service', 'Person', 'Team', 'Role', 'Channel', 'Repo', 'CodeModule',
                       'PR', 'Deploy', 'Ticket', 'Thread', 'Doc', 'Decision', 'Incident', 'Alert']
  AND (n.id IN $ids
       OR toLower(n.name) CONTAINS toLower($text)
       OR toLower(n.title) CONTAINS toLower($text))
WITH viewer, n,
     coalesce(n.access_level, CASE WHEN 'Deploy' IN labels(n) THEN 'internal' END) AS level
WITH viewer, n, level
WHERE level IS NULL
   OR level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (owner:Team)-[:OWNS]->(n)
RETURN n.id AS id,
       labels(n)[0] AS label,
       coalesce(n.name, n.title) AS name,
       n.tier AS tier,
       n.access_level AS access_level,
       owner.id AS owner_team
ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.id IN $ids THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         CASE WHEN labels(n)[0] IN ['Service', 'Team', 'Person'] THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         name
LIMIT 10

MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH p = (:Service {id: $service})-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..3]->(dep:Service)

MATCH (dep)<-[:DEPLOYED_TO]-(d:Deploy)-[:INCLUDES]->(pr:PR)

payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH (a:Alert {id: $alert}), (pr:PR {id: $pr})
WHERE pr.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(pr)
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: a, targetNode: pr,
                   relTypes: ['FIRED_ON', 'DEPENDS_ON', 'DEPLOYED_TO', 'INCLUDES'],

YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.id] AS node_ids,

       [r IN relationships(path) | type(r)] AS rel_types,

ORDER BY weight ASC
LIMIT 1

payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH (dec:Decision)
WHERE (dec.id = $entity
       OR dec.service IN [$entity, $entity_short]
       OR (dec)<-[:IMPLEMENTS]-(:PR {id: $entity}))
  AND (dec.access_level IN $open_levels
       OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(dec))
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec)-[:DISCUSSED_IN]->(th:Thread)
WHERE th.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(th)
WITH viewer, dec, collect(DISTINCT th.id) AS threads,
     collect(DISTINCT {id: th.id, gist: substring(th.text, 0, 300)}) AS thread_notes
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec)-[:DISCUSSED_IN]->(hidden:Thread)
WHERE NOT (hidden.access_level IN $open_levels
           OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(hidden))
WITH viewer, dec, threads, thread_notes, count(DISTINCT hidden) AS hidden_threads, collect(DISTINCT hidden.team)[0] AS hidden_team
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old)
WHERE old.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(old)
WITH viewer, dec, threads, thread_notes, hidden_threads, hidden_team, collect(DISTINCT old.id) AS supersedes
OPTIONAL MATCH (newer)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(dec)
WHERE newer.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(newer)
WITH viewer, dec, threads, thread_notes, hidden_threads, hidden_team, supersedes,
     collect(DISTINCT newer.id) AS superseded_by
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc:Incident)-[:AFFECTED]->(s:Service)
WHERE (s.id = dec.service OR s.name = dec.service)
  AND (inc.access_level IN $open_levels
       OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(inc))
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc)-[:RECORDED_IN]->(pm)
WHERE pm.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(pm)
RETURN dec.id AS decision_id,
       coalesce(dec.title, dec.name) AS title,
       dec.updated_at AS updated_at,
       dec.access_level AS access_level,
       threads,
       thread_notes,
       hidden_threads,
       hidden_team,
       supersedes,
       superseded_by,
       collect(DISTINCT {incident: inc.id, postmortem: pm.id}) AS incidents
ORDER BY dec.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 5

payload.text: PR pr:482 lowered the pricing cache TTL to 5s on svc:pricing via deploy:991, which connects to alert:A-3001 on svc:checkout across svc:promo-engine.
Rejected: pr:479 on svc:checkout via deploy:990 only modifies copy in mod:checkout/i18n/en.json, which cannot cause the latency spike.

The change in pr:482 contradicts architectural decision adr:011 established after past incident inc:INC-0307 and postmortem pm:INC-0307, which requires the pricing cache TTL to remain at 300s or higher.

payload.reason: Pick who to contact for svc:pricing, where the root cause landed.
Pick who to contact for svc:pricing, where the root cause landed.
payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH (svc:Service {id: $service})-[:BUILT_FROM]->(:Repo)<-[:IN_REPO]-(pr:PR)<-[r:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]-(p:Person)
WHERE pr.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(pr)
WITH viewer, svc, p,
     sum(CASE type(r) WHEN 'AUTHORED' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS code_score,
     sum(CASE type(r) WHEN 'AUTHORED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS authored
OPTIONAL MATCH (i:Incident)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(p)
WHERE (i)-[:AFFECTED]->(svc)
  AND (i.access_level IN $open_levels
       OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(i))
WITH svc, p, code_score, authored, 5 * count(DISTINCT i) AS incident_score
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(team:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (owner:Team)-[:OWNS]->(svc)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(lead_role:Role {id: 'role:eng-manager'})
RETURN p.id AS id,
       p.name AS name,
       code_score,
       incident_score,
       authored,
       code_score + incident_score AS score,
       team.id AS current_team,
       owner.id AS owner_team,
       team.id = owner.id AS on_owner_team,
       lead_role IS NOT NULL AND team.id = owner.id AS is_lead
UNION
MATCH (owner:Team)-[:OWNS]->(:Service {id: $service})
MATCH (lead:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(owner)
WHERE (lead)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(:Role {id: 'role:eng-manager'})
RETURN lead.id AS id,
       lead.name AS name,
       0 AS code_score,
       0 AS incident_score,
       0 AS authored,
       0 AS score,
       owner.id AS current_team,
       owner.id AS owner_team,
       true AS on_owner_team,
       true AS is_lead
